title: set_leverage pre-flight sends 17 non-crypto symbols (SPY, QQQ, TLT, MES...) to Bybit on every boot via ml_entry/claude_desk symbol lists: 68 failed calls in 27 min today at 21 restarts/day; filter by venue
note: [HEALTH-REVIEW-20261104] MEASURED: journalctl ict-trader-live 18:56-19:23Z: 68 'set_leverage pre-flight ... symbol invalid' WARNINGs (bybit_2 26, bybit_portfolio 26, bybit_1 16). Cause (code, p0.95): src/main.py _apply_per_account_leverage -> _symbols_for_account takes the union of every rostered strategy's symbols; ml_entry (bybit_2, bybit_portfolio) and claude_desk (bybit_1) list equity/futures symbols. Wasted Bybit REST calls per boot; one 'Too many visits' rate-limit line in the same window (correlation, not shown causal). Exact fix: in the preflight loop, skip symbols the account's venue does not list (e.g. not endswith('USDT') for market_type linear), leaving _resolve_tick_symbols untouched unless it also pulls them. Closing observation: 0 such WARNINGs over one boot.
